package.description: Extract hidden metadata from digital files including EXIF camera settings, GPS coordinates from photos, ID3 music tags, and other formats.

en-US.description: Extract hidden metadata from digital files including EXIF camera settings, GPS coordinates from photos, ID3 music tags, and other formats.
en-US.longDescription:
Metadata Viewer is a simple tool for viewing and analyzing hidden metadata embedded in digital files. Whether you're examining photographs, audio files, documents, or executables, this software reveals the technical details and information stored within.

For image files, this program extracts EXIF data including camera settings, exposure information, and timestamps. It displays GPS coordinates showing exactly where photos were taken, making it invaluable for organizing travel photography or verifying location data. The software also reads IPTC metadata like photographer credits and image descriptions, XMP data for advanced editing information, and specialized formats like GeoTIFF for geographic imagery and ICC Profiles for color management.

Beyond images, the software supports ID3 tags in music files (displaying artist, album, and track information), Lyrics3 data for song lyrics, and C2PA JUMBF for content authenticity and provenance tracking. It handles professional formats including Photoshop IRB (Image Resource Blocks), FlashPix metadata, AFCP data, and manufacturer-specific MakerNotes from various camera brands.

With support for over a dozen metadata standards, this tool is essential for photographers verifying their work, digital forensics professionals analyzing file authenticity, content managers organizing media libraries, or anyone curious about the hidden information their files contain. The intuitive interface displays all metadata in an easy-to-read format, allowing you to explore every technical detail embedded in your digital content.

Supported metadata formats: EXIF, GPS, IPTC, XMP, JFIF, MakerNotes, C2PA JUMBF, GeoTIFF, ICC Profile, Photoshop IRB, FlashPix, AFCP, ID3, Lyrics3, and more
en-US.name: Vovsoft Metadata Viewer
